forms.ex: Bringst du mir bitte ein Glas Wasser?
forms.exEn: Could you bring me a glass of water, please?

forms.why: mit = with: you bring it with you.
forms.ex: Soll ich zur Party einen Kuchen mitbringen?
forms.exEn: Shall I bring a cake to the party?

forms.why: ver- = away, used up: you bring the time along until it is gone.
forms.ex: Wir verbringen den Sommer am Meer.
forms.exEn: We're spending the summer by the sea.

forms.en: sich einbringen: get involved, contribute; einbringen: bring in (money, a harvest), table (a bill)
forms.clue: to get involved (sich; in a team)
forms.why: ein = in: you bring yourself into a group.
forms.ex: Jeder kann sich mit Ideen einbringen.
forms.exEn: Everyone can contribute ideas.

forms.why: bei = with, beside: you bring a skill to someone's side.
forms.ex: Mein Vater hat mir das Schwimmen beigebracht.
forms.exEn: My father taught me to swim.

forms.why: Learn it as a word: um- does not give the meaning here; it simply means to kill.
forms.ex: Im Film bringt der Gärtner den Chef um.
forms.exEn: In the film the gardener kills the boss.

forms.clue: to fix, to mount (on a wall)
forms.why: an = on, at: you bring a thing onto a surface.
forms.ex: Wir bringen das Regal an der Wand an.
forms.exEn: We're putting the shelf up on the wall.

forms.en: accommodate, put up (guests); find room for
forms.clue: to put up (guests for the night)
forms.why: unter = under: you bring someone under a roof.
forms.ex: Wir können euch im Gästezimmer unterbringen.
forms.exEn: We can put you up in the guest room.

forms.ex: Die Stadt kümmert sich um die Unterbringung der Flüchtlinge.
forms.exEn: The city is taking care of housing the refugees.

forms.why: vor = forward: you bring an argument forward.
forms.ex: Er hat in der Sitzung gute Argumente vorgebracht.
forms.exEn: He put forward good arguments in the meeting.

forms.clue: to take back (books to the library)
forms.why: zurück = back: you bring it back.
forms.ex: Ich muss die Bücher in die Bibliothek zurückbringen.
forms.exEn: I have to take the books back to the library.

forms.why: weg = away: you bring it away.
forms.ex: Bringst du bitte den Müll weg?
forms.exEn: Will you take the rubbish out, please?

forms.why: her = here, toward the speaker: you bring it to where I am.
forms.ex: Kannst du mir die Tasche bitte herbringen?
forms.exEn: Can you bring me the bag, please?

forms.why: hin = there, away from the speaker: you bring it over there.
forms.ex: Ich bringe dich mit dem Auto hin.
forms.exEn: I'll take you there in the car.

forms.en: drop off, bring round (on the way)
forms.clue: to drop off (on your way past)
forms.why: vorbei = past, by: you bring it by on your way.
forms.ex: Ich bringe dir das Buch morgen vorbei.
forms.exEn: I'll drop the book off for you tomorrow.

forms.why: er- = reaching a result: you bring about a result.
forms.ex: Sie müssen einen Nachweis über Ihr Einkommen erbringen.
forms.exEn: You have to provide proof of your income.

forms.clue: to talk someone out of (a plan)
forms.why: ab = off, away: you bring someone off a plan.
forms.ex: Niemand kann ihn von seinem Plan abbringen.
forms.exEn: Nobody can talk him out of his plan.

forms.why: auf = up: you bring the money or the strength up.
forms.ex: Wir können so viel Geld nicht aufbringen.
forms.exEn: We can't raise that much money.

forms.why: aufbringen also means to make angry: someone stirred up.
forms.ex: Die Kunden waren sehr aufgebracht.
forms.exEn: The customers were very angry.

forms.en: release, bring out (a product, an album); get out (a word)
forms.clue: to release (a new product, an album)
forms.why: heraus = out: you bring a product out onto the market.
forms.ex: Die Band bringt im Herbst ein neues Album heraus.
forms.exEn: The band is bringing out a new album in the autumn.

forms.why: zusammen = together: you bring people together.
forms.ex: Das Straßenfest bringt die Nachbarn zusammen.
forms.exEn: The street party brings the neighbours together.

forms.en: help someone get further, get someone somewhere
forms.clue: to help (someone) get further, to get somewhere
forms.why: weiter = on, further: it brings you further on.
forms.ex: Diese Diskussion bringt uns nicht weiter.
forms.exEn: This discussion isn't getting us anywhere.

rare.why: A reviewer was not certain it is never used (older or literary German), so the game never calls it wrong.
